name: 2018-1c-parcial2
title: Mars Rover
description: A Mars Rover on a plane, with a position and a cardinal heading, receives a String of single-character commands (f, b, l, r) and must stop processing at the first invalid command. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: The natural temptation is a case-like dispatch on the heading character and on the command character; the good design replaces both with polymorphic heading objects and command objects, plus stopping the command stream on the first invalid command.
